sourceProvenance.title: Napolitan Dance (Swan Lake)
sourceProvenance.composer: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky; arrangement by Laurence Sardain
sourceProvenance.edition: Mutopia-2006/12/22-896; public-domain arrangement for trumpet, percussion and piano; Pianify keyboard adaptation preserves the melody and piano accompaniment and omits percussion
normalization: The first sounding note is normalized to 0 seconds.
Exact simultaneous duplicate pitches are reduced to one note.
Repeated pitches are separated by a 20 ms release gap when the source sustain overlaps the next attack.
No pitch is transposed and no source note is removed to fit the visual keyboard.
